versions.changelog:
Initial release of Seedance 视频生成 Skill:

- Supports generating high-quality AI videos using Huoshan Yinqing Seedance 2.0 models via Ark platform API.
- Multi-modal input: text, image, video, and audio references for versatile content creation.
- Two model options: standard (high quality) and fast (faster results).
- Flexible parameters: video duration, aspect ratio, watermark, and optional audio generation.
- Provides detailed workflow for task submission, status polling, and result retrieval.
